title: Adjunction construction of maps from etale tensor sections
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\mathcal O_{\mathrm{et}}(u:V\to T)=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ its structure-ring sheaf. Use the Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] and presheaves of modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let $M$ be any Zariski $\mathcal O_T$-module and $G$ any sheaf of $\mathcal O_{\mathrm{et}}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $P_M$ be the module presheaf $P_M(u)=\Gamma(V,u^*M)$ with the unit-normalized restrictions [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] and pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $G_u(A)=G(A\hookrightarrow V\xrightarrow{u}T)$ for the Zariski module on $V$, for $A\subseteq V$ open, and $G_T(W)=G(W\hookrightarrow T)$. For $i_W:W\hookrightarrow T$, write $\kappa_W:M|_W\xrightarrow{\sim}i_W^*M$ for the unit-compatible comparison [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction]. Given an $\mathcal O_T$-linear map $\beta:M\to G_T$, define $b_u:M\to u_*G_u$ on each open $W\subseteq T$ by
$$b_{u,W}(m)=G(V_W\to W)(\beta_W(m)),\qquad V_W=u^{-1}W.$$
Let $a_u:u^*M\to G_u$ be the adjoint of $b_u$ under the scheme-module adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and let $\Theta_{M,G}(\beta)_u=\Gamma(V,a_u)$. Then these components form a morphism of module presheaves $\Theta_{M,G}(\beta):P_M\to G$ and satisfy
$$\Theta_{M,G}(\beta)_{i_W}\circ\Gamma(W,\kappa_W)=\beta_W$$
for every open $W$. The assignment is natural in $M$ and $G$: for $h:M'\to M$ and a module map $k:G\to G'$,
$$\Theta_{M',G'}(k_T\circ\beta\circ h)=k\circ\Theta_{M,G}(\beta)\circ P_h,$$
where $(P_h)_u=\Gamma(V,u^*h)$ and $k_T$ is restriction to Zariski opens [lem-sc-etale-tensor-sections-map-naturality]. No quasi-coherence hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The unit equation for conjugateEquiv identifies the Hom transpose under the composite adjunction of c followed by a_v with b_v followed by inverse pushforward composition. Injectivity of the u-adjunction Hom equivalence and step 2 show that the f-transpose of c followed by a_v is a_u followed by d_f. Evaluate at the whole open and simplify the unit restriction there. The top-open isomorphisms commute with f by morphismRestrict_ι and cancellation of their underlying scheme isomorphisms. Functoriality of G now gives the presheaf naturality square. Assemble the explicitly additive components into a natural transformation.

proof.text: For an open W, use the generic unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app equation for the comparison defining tensorOpenSectionIso. Naturality with the equality W.ι preimage W = top and the ordinary restriction-unit formula show that the inverse open-section comparison is the tensor unit on W followed by this equality transport. Naturality of a_W and the adjunction equation then replace its value by b_W. The remaining three arrows in the small etale site compose to tensorExtensionBaseOpenIso.inv: their underlying arrows are equal after composing with the monomorphism W.ι. Applying G gives the required open normalization. This directly proves the unit calculation, without the separate open-restriction compatibility theorem.

proof.text: Naturality of a module-presheaf morphism k on the base-change arrow proves b(k_T beta h)=h followed by b(beta) followed by u_*k_u. Apply the two naturality identities of homEquiv.symm and then take top-open sections. Naturality of k on the top-open isomorphism gives the asserted equality in both variables. This is proved componentwise, so the separate tensor-sections-map naturality theorem is unnecessary. Empty schemes, empty opens, zero modules and identity arrows satisfy the same functorial and unit identities.
